questions.question_english: Identify the incorrect statement regarding the CGHS beneficiary ID.
options_english: It can be transferred to a sibling in case of the beneficiary’s death.
It is a unique 7-digit numeric code generated upon enrollment.
It remains the same even if the beneficiary shifts from a serving to a pensioner category.
A dependent child’s ID expires or is deactivated once they cross the dependency age limit.
questions.explanation_english: Every beneficiary receives a unique, nontransferable identification number that remains unchanged when transitioning from serving status to pensioner status. Upon a beneficiary’s death or when a dependent child exceeds the statutory age limit, that specific identification ID is permanently deactivated and cannot be transferred to siblings or others.

questions.question_english: Who among the following is defined as an “Authorised Medical Attendant” (AMA) under the CS(MA) Rules, 1944?
options_english: The medical officer appointed by the Government to attend its employees in a specific station
Any private medical practitioner chosen by the employee
Only the Chief Medical Officer of a district hospital
Any registered pharmacist in a government dispensary
questions.explanation_english: Under the Central Services (Medical Attendance) Rules, 1944, an Authorised Medical Attendant is a medical officer appointed or recognized by the Government to provide medical consultation and treatment to public servants at a given duty station. Employees must consult their designated officer for initial consultations, medical certificates, and necessary specialized referrals.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। केंद्रीय सेवा (चिकित्सा उपस्थिति) नियम, 1944 के तहत, एक अधिकृत चिकित्सा सहायक एक चिकित्सा अधिकारी है जिसे सरकार द्वारा नियुक्त या मान्यता प्राप्त किया गया है ताकि वह एक निश्चित ड्यूटी स्टेशन पर सार्वजनिक सेवकों को चिकित्सा परामर्श और उपचार प्रदान कर सके। कर्मचारियों को प्रारंभिक परामर्श, चिकित्सा प्रमाणपत्र और आवश्यक विशेष संदर्भों के लिए अपने निर्धारित अधिकारी से परामर्श करना चाहिए।
key_facts: CS(MA) Rules, 1944 define the role of Authorised Medical Attendant.
AMA is appointed by the Government for specific duty stations.
Printed answer key: (A) The medical officer appointed by the Government to attend its employees in a specific station.
